title: Automated Technical Support Documentation Synthesis
business: A mid-sized software firm managing thousands of legacy technical manuals and internal support tickets.
problem: Support engineers spend excessive time manually cross-referencing disparate documentation and historical ticket logs to resolve recurring customer issues.
solution: Deploying Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as an internal agentic assistant that leverages its tool-calling capabilities to query documentation repositories and summarize resolution paths from historical data.
steps: Configure an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint using vLLM with a 262,144 token context window to ingest large technical manuals.
Define custom MCP-based tools within the Qwen-Agent framework to allow the model to fetch specific documentation snippets.
Implement the Assistant class to handle multi-turn conversations, ensuring the model uses the provided tools for accurate retrieval.
Standardize output formats using prompt templates to ensure consistent, actionable resolution steps for support staff.
outcome: Support engineers receive synthesized, context-aware resolution summaries, significantly reducing the time required to navigate internal knowledge bases.
limitation: The model may experience out-of-memory (OOM) errors when processing extremely large context windows; this can be checked by monitoring system memory usage and reducing the context length to 32,768 tokens if necessary.

code.content:
from qwen_agent.agents import Assistant
# Define LLM with custom endpoint
llm_cfg = {'model': 'Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507', 'model_server': 'http://localhost:8000/v1', 'api_key': 'EMPTY'}
# Define tools for document retrieval
tools = [{'mcpServers': {'fetch': {'command': 'uvx', 'args': ['mcp-server-fetch']}}}]
# Initialize agent
bot = Assistant(llm=llm_cfg, function_list=tools)
